title: Grade 9 · Session 22 · Build V7
note: Holes are counted from the left, or from the front, as the build faces the camera.
partsSummary: 19 Friction Pegs, one 15x5 Block, one 5x11 Plate, two 10x5 Blocks, one Beam 9, one Beam 11, one Beam 5 and one 11x5 H Block.

steps.instruction: Lay the blue 15x5 block flat on the mat.
Push a peg into the block's front row, hole 5 from the left.
Push a peg into the front row, hole 10 from the left.
Push a peg into the front row, hole 12 from the left.
Push a peg into the front row, hole 1 at the left end.
Press the plate down onto the two left pegs, smooth side up.
Push a peg into the plate's left side, hole 3 from the front.
Push a peg into the plate's left side, hole 6 from the front.
Push a peg into the plate's left side, hole 9 from the front.
Push a peg into the plate's right side, hole 9 from the front.
Push a peg into the plate's right side, hole 3 from the front.
Slide the red beam onto the right pegs, using holes 2 and 8.
Stand the grey block upright and push it onto the three left pegs.
Push a peg through the red beam's hole 3 from the front.
Push a peg through the red beam's hole 7 from the front.
Stand the second grey block upright and push it onto both red-beam pegs.
Push a peg into the left grey block's front end, top hole.
Push a peg into the right grey block's front end, top hole.
Press the blue 11 beam onto both top pegs, using holes 1 and 8.
Push a peg into the blue 11 beam's hole 5 from the left.
Push a peg into the blue 11 beam's hole 7 from the left.
Push a peg into the plate's front edge, hole 2 from the left.
Push a peg into the plate's front edge, hole 5 from the left.
Press the blue 5 beam onto the front pegs, using holes 1 and 4.
Push a peg into the blue 5 beam's hole 3 from the left.
Push a peg into the blue 5 beam's hole 5 from the left.
Press the blue H block onto the four front pegs, top and bottom.
